title: Eliciting the Recall Capacity of Linear Attention
abstract: arXiv:2611.32969v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Linear attention models exhibit a disproportionate deficit relative to softmax attention in associative recall (AR) in language modeling. We investigate this gap through natural language evaluations, synthetic recall tasks, and targeted training interventions. Using a synthetic setting, we quantify the role of state-size in how many items can be recalled from memory and find a similar empirical scaling across the tested linear-attention architectures. Testing this relationship reveals that even a single layer at scale can learn to retrieve thousands of associations across long distances. Yet, standard language model training does not reliably teach a linear model to copy from context, whereas a comparable softmax model learns to do so. Considering this, we strengthen recall supervision during training through in-context sentence repetition and context-sensitive loss reweighting. Both methods improve recall-intensive benchmark performance

translated_title: 激发线性注意力的召回能力
translated_abstract: 在语言建模中，线性注意力模型在关联召回（AR）方面相对于softmax注意力表现出不成比例的显著差距。我们通过自然语言评估、合成召回任务以及针对性的训练干预来研究这一差距。在合成实验设置中，我们量化了状态规模在决定可从记忆中召回多少个项目方面所起的作用，并在所测试的各线性注意力架构中发现了相似的实证缩放规律。对这一关系的验证表明，即使是大规模下的单层模型也能够学会跨长距离检索数千个关联。然而，标准的语言模型训练并不能可靠地教会线性模型从上下文中复制信息，而同等规模的softmax模型却能够学会做到这一点。有鉴于此，我们通过上下文内的句子复述任务和对上下文敏感的损失重加权两种方法，在训练过程中加强了召回监督。这两种方法都提升了召回密集型基准任务的性能。
tldr: 该研究揭示了线性注意力模型的召回容量随状态规模缩放的规律，并提出了上下文句子复述和上下文敏感损失重加权两种训练干预方法，有效弥补了线性模型在关联召回能力上与softmax注意力的差距。
